metaDescription: How {siteName} works for guests and owners: search with Jewish-friendly filters, book short stays on the site and pay the host on arrival, or contact owners directly for monthly rentals and sales. No booking fees.

hero.title: From search to keys, in three simple steps
hero.lead: {siteName} connects guests with owners: book short stays on the site and pay the host when you arrive, or contact the owner directly for monthly rentals and sales. No booking fees, no middlemen — and checks at every step to keep scammers out.

guests.title: For guests and buyers
guests.lead: Find a home that fits your family and your traditions.

step1.title: Search and filter
step1.body: Search by city, dates and price, then narrow it down with the details that matter to you.

step2.title: Check the listing and the owner
step2.body: Look through the photos, the details and the house rules. Verification badges show what the owner has proven to us, and the “Last updated” date shows the listing is current.

step3.title: Book or get in touch
step3.body: Short stays and hotels: pick your dates, the booking is confirmed right away, and you pay the host when you arrive. Monthly rentals and sales: tap WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, Messenger, phone or email, and a ready message in your language opens in the app. We take no payments and charge no booking fees.

owners.title: For owners and businesses
owners.lead: Reach Jewish and Israeli guests and buyers — for free.

step1.title: Verify your phone and post for free
step1.body: Sign up with Google or a code sent to your email, confirm your phone number with a code and post your listing step by step. Write it once — we translate it into the other four languages.

step2.title: Automatic checks and review
step2.body: Every new or edited listing goes through automatic checks, and your first listing is always reviewed by a person. Most listings go live right away; some wait for a moderator first. We email you either way.

step3.title: Bookings and messages
step3.body: For short stays and hotels, guests book on the site and you get an alert with the booking details. For monthly rentals and sales, they reach you in the apps you choose, in the order you choose. Your contact details are shown only to signed-in users, which keeps bots away.

badges.title: Verification badges, explained
badges.lead: Badges show what an owner has proven to us. More badges mean more trust — but always follow the safety tips too.

phone.label: Phone verified
phone.body: The owner confirmed their phone number with a code by SMS or WhatsApp.

id.label: ID verified
id.body: The owner sent an ID document and a selfie, and our team checked them by hand.

owner.label: Owner verified
owner.body: The owner proved they own the property or may rent it out. In Georgia that's an extract from the Public Registry (NAPR) in the same name as their ID; hotels send their business registration.

property.label: Property verified
property.body: A live video call with our team, or a visit from a local representative, confirms that the place is real and matches the listing.

faq.title: Common questions

q1.a: Searching, contacting owners and posting a listing are all free. We don't charge booking fees.

q2.q: Can I book or pay through the site?
q2.a: Short stays and hotel rooms are booked on the site: pick your dates, see the total price, and the booking is confirmed right away. You pay the host when you arrive, not through the site. For monthly rentals and sales you agree the details and the payment with the owner directly. Never pay before you've checked the owner and seen the place, in person or on a live video call.

q3.q: Why do I have to sign in to see contact details?
q3.a: It stops bots from collecting owners' phone numbers. Signing in takes one tap with Google, or a code sent to your email.

q4.q: How do I know a listing is real?
q4.a: Look for verification badges and a recent “Last updated” date, and read our Safety Center. If something feels wrong, report the listing — we check every report.
